text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Think there'll be a Triple Crown champion this year?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Beats me! But personally, I've got my eye on…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the long-awaited Satsuki Sho. Expectations couldn't be higher for the first leg of the Triple Crown. However…

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hey, about this "Smart Falcon"… Doesn't she usually compete in dirt races?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: I wonder why she's running today. Is she gonna be okay?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Maybe she's just as good on turf. At any rate, I've heard her concerts are a blast…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: People seem shocked to see me here. Figures, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah. I knew this would happen.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: On dirt, I'm the up-and-coming Umadol everyone's talking about…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But here, I'm just a regular runner. It makes sense for everyone to be a little confused.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's fine with me, though! I have faith in myself.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm super-duper nervous, but… I've got to believe I can do it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I've already come this far. The only thing left to do is grab that center spot!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna show all my fans just how good I can sing on a big stage!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her eyes waver, but only slightly. Nonetheless, she steps up to the challenge, choosing to believe in herself…
choice_data_list: L-O-V-E! Who do we love? Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …Haha, I should know this by now. I'm not on my own.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the cheer. Time to go! ☆
